name: bizplug-airlines
description: The airlines plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: flight status and support requests. It works from the business's own published profile, covering baggage, check-in, policies and support contacts, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.

interface.shortDescription: Flight status and support requests for airlines businesses.
interface.longDescription: The airlines plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: flight status and support requests. defaultPrompt: What's the baggage allowance, and how do I change a flight?
How do I contact the business?

test_cases.expect: Calls show_menu, which shows the menu card; does not list the options again, or lists them exactly as returned where there is no card.
Calls lookup_flight_status and answers from the published profile.

test_cases.prompt: What's the baggage allowance, and how do I change a flight?
test_cases.expect: Answers from the business profile, or says it is not covered and offers contact details.
Calls submit_support_request only after the customer has confirmed the details, and reports that the business still has to confirm.

test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about the ocean.
